data.gender_notes: Celestiel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Celestiel is derived from the Latin word celestia, which means 'heaven' or 'sky'. In Christian tradition, this name symbolizes a connection to the divine and a focus on the spiritual realm. Celestiel may be given to a child as a reminder of the heavenly realms and the heavenly Father. The name Celestiel carries the meaning “From heaven” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Celestiel usually hope their child will grow to embody from heaven and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Celestiel total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: סלסטיאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם סלסטיאל מורכב משתי מילים: 'סלסט' שמקורו בלטינית ומשמעותו שמיים, ו'אל' שמקורו בעברית ומשמעותו אלוהים. השם נגזר מהמילה הלטינית 'coelestis', שפירושה שמיוני, והוא קשור למושגים של שמים ואלוהים.

in_greek.name: Σελεστιέλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Σελεστιέλ προέρχεται από το λατινικό 'coelestis', που σημαίνει ουράνιος, και το εβραϊκό 'אל', που σημαίνει Θεός. Το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με έννοιες ουρανίων και θεϊκών αγγέλων, και είναι χαρακτηριστικό της παράδοσης των Χριστιανικών ονομάτων.

in_latin.name: Coelestiel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Coelestiel derivatur ex latino 'coelestis', quod significat caelestis, et hebraico 'אל', quod significat Deus. Nomen hoc coniungit conceptos caeli et Dei, et est proprium traditionis christianae nominum.

in_english.name: Celestiel
in_english.long_meaning: The name Celestiel is derived from the Latin 'coelestis', meaning heavenly or celestial, and the Hebrew 'אל', meaning God.
